commitments.detail: Provide training on the new voice-authentication system and privacy rights.
Notify unions at least 7 days prior to the rollout.
A detailed privacy notice will be provided to all employees prior to the rollout.
The union will be consulted at least 5 days prior to the rollout.
The vendor will retain voiceprints for no longer than 90 days.
The vendor is prohibited from monitoring off-hours voice recordings.
Voice recordings may not be used for any secondary purposes without additional consent.
All covered workers must provide opt-in consent prior to the deployment of the voice-authentication access system.
Voice recordings will be retained for a period of 90 days for account authentication purposes only.
The system will only monitor employee voices during work hours and not during off-hours.
Provide training on the new voice-authentication system and its implications for privacy and security.
Notify the union representatives 7 days prior to the rollout date.
Implement a policy for deleting voiceprints after 90 days of inactivity.
